source.name: HOL Light proof cards for openai/math
source.method: Selected steps of eleven families proved again in HOL Light, independently of Lean, each card with negative controls that must fail; warm and cold runs recorded on 8 October. The author states that no card proves a headline theorem of the release. Compared first at release commit adc7f124 and updated by the author for fd4aeeb2.

fields.hol_checks: Per family: what each HOL Light card certifies and how it relates to the release's Lean, in the author's words.

adopted.what: What each card certifies and its relation to the release's Lean, quoted under CC BY 4.0
adopted.where: family pages, under checks in another proof assistant

hol_checks.certifies: The seven placed Moser vertices lie in the three-label region, the 11 edges have length exactly 1, and no proper 3-labelling exists; exact arithmetic in ℚ(√3,√11)
hol_checks.relation: Independent method for a Lean-covered step

hol_checks.certifies: Two explicit polynomial maps on ℝ⁵ are mutually inverse and send the paper's f to the first coordinate
hol_checks.relation: Independent polynomial-identity check; upstream fd4aeeb2 now also covers the October 5 stable-coordinate result. This HOL card does not prove its noncoordinate obstruction

hol_checks.certifies: The algebra of the invariant box: stationary corner (9/2, 7/2, 33/7), face signs, the D-equation from the C-equation
hol_checks.relation: Checks algebra inside a result that is paper-only in the release (Lean covers dimensions 3–9 only); the ODE and PDE reduction are not covered

hol_checks.certifies: Switch volumes 4·PI/81 and 1/PI and the radii there, for any positive constant PI
hol_checks.relation: Cross-check of a Lean-covered result; on-screen value

hol_checks.certifies: The same with HOL's real π: ties at 4π/81 (radii 1/3, 2/9) and at 1/π (area 2); the ball loses at 1/π
The paper's two exact rationals and both bounds < 149/150
hol_checks.relation: Cross-check of a Lean-covered result; on-screen value

hol_checks.certifies: A finite nonempty set in the plane is not invariant under a nonzero translation
hol_checks.relation: Cross-check of a Lean-covered result; on-screen value

hol_checks.certifies: x² + y² = 1 ⇒ |2xy| ≤ 1 (real form of the sharpness case)
hol_checks.relation: Cross-check of a Lean-covered result; on-screen value

hol_checks.certifies: 2.664·10⁻⁷ < 355/113 − π < 2.669·10⁻⁷ and 24.5 < 1/(355³ sin² 355) < 24.7, so the Flint–Hills partial sum through n = 355 exceeds 24
hol_checks.relation: Hook card; Flint–Hills convergence stays paper-only

hol_checks.certifies: q = (1+2Dt)^(−1/2) solves q′ = −Dq³ with q(0) = 1, and the leave constant tends to 1/(2√2)
hol_checks.relation: The heuristic's arithmetic only; nothing about the random process

hol_checks.certifies: The J₁ power series has derivative J₀ − J₁/x on (1, 2), and that derivative vanishes somewhere in (1.8411, 1.8412)
hol_checks.relation: Illustration; not that this is the first zero, nor that the series are "the" Bessel functions

hol_checks.certifies: Counting step only: at most ⌈π/α⌉ multiples of α fit in an open interval of length π
hol_checks.relation: Not the bounce claim; the unfolding geometry is not certified
